title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE LATEST ARCADE WORK
why: The card was stamped v23.64 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names the builds of 2026-10-11 and 12: the 1 player arcade, hold E to loot again, credits and score as one, the title fitting any zoom, and fleeing pillagers turning on whoever shoots them.
now: The what is new card names the latest arcade work.

edits.anchor: 'THIS IS AN ALPHA. Things will break. When something does, the game writes it into your run report and tells you so; that report is how it gets fixed.',
